# ANT Automobile

> ANT Automobile is a student engineering team in Türkiye that designs electric vehicles with its own know-how. Its first car, a two-seat, four-wheel electric city car, will race in the Elektromobil category of the TEKNOFEST 2027 Efficiency Challenge (International Electric Vehicle Races). The website is available in English and Turkish.

The team brings mechanics, electronics and software to the same table, designs every part of the car itself and backs every decision with measurement.

- Vision: to become an engineering community in Türkiye that creates its own knowledge of electric mobility, designs its own vehicles and passes that knowledge on to the next generation.
- Mission: to build a real car from start to finish with our own hands; to put efficiency at the heart of the design; to design the car's control and battery electronics within the team; to document everything so the next team starts where we left off.
- Values: honest measurement, safety first, precision, building together.
- Work areas: body and design; mechanical systems (chassis, suspension, brakes, steering); power and energy (battery, motor, power electronics); control and software (vehicle control unit, simulation, driving strategy).
- Status (October 2026): the rules have been studied and the whole car has been modelled and analysed digitally; the team is preparing the prototype for production. Next: track testing and racing at TEKNOFEST 2027.
- Team: Ömer Ziya Atmacı, Cem Yılmaz, Kadir Can Kahraman, Tuğra Çimen, Bilal Örnek, Fatih Piltan. Faculty advisor: Ömer Tarhan (omertarhan@antautomobile.org).
- Sponsorship: the team is looking for support from institutions and sponsors. Sponsors get visibility at Türkiye's largest technology festival, on the car and alongside the team.
- Contact: info@antautomobile.org (sponsorship, press, academic collaboration). Privacy requests: kvkk@antautomobile.org.
- Mascot: Wolti, a small charging socket with antennae, derived from the ANT logo.
